name: Ox
otherStatistics: Passive Perception 10. No listed skills, special senses, or languages.
appearance: A broad-bodied draft bovine with horns and a heavy neck.

sections.Printed source: Wizards of the Coast, Volo's Guide to Monsters, first printing (November 2016), Appendix A, pp. 207–208.
sections.Traits:
Charge. If the animal moves at least 20 ft. straight toward a target and hits it with Gore during the same turn, add 7 (2d6) piercing damage.
Beast of Burden. Treat the ox as Huge when determining its carrying capacity.
sections.Actions: Gore. Melee weapon attack, +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. On a hit, deal 7 (1d6 + 4) piercing damage.

name: Stench Kow
otherStatistics: Resists cold, fire, and poison damage. Darkvision 60 ft., passive Perception 10. No listed skills or languages.
appearance: A misshapen orange and moss-green bison with a shaggy shoulder hump, curved horns, and lean hindquarters.

sections.Printed source: Wizards of the Coast, Volo's Guide to Monsters, first printing (November 2016), Appendix A, pp. 207–208.
sections.Traits:
Charge. If the animal moves at least 20 ft. straight toward a target and hits it with Gore during the same turn, add 7 (2d6) piercing damage.
Stench. A creature other than a stench kow that starts its turn within 5 ft. of the kow must make a DC 12 CON save. On a failure it is poisoned until the start of its next turn. On a success it is immune to the Stench of all stench kows for 1 hour.
sections.Actions: Gore. Melee weapon attack, +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. On a hit, deal 7 (1d6 + 4) piercing damage.

name: Swarm of Rot Grubs
classification: Medium Swarm of Tiny Beasts, unaligned
otherStatistics: Resists piercing and slashing damage. Immune to charmed, frightened, grappled, paralyzed, petrified, prone, and restrained. Blindsight 10 ft., passive Perception 6. No listed skills or languages.
appearance: A cluster of finger-sized maggots with visibly segmented bodies.

sections.Printed source: Wizards of the Coast, Volo's Guide to Monsters, first printing (November 2016), Appendix A, p. 208.
sections.Traits: Swarm. The swarm can share its space with other creatures and move through any opening that admits a Tiny maggot. It cannot regain hit points or gain temporary hit points.
sections.Actions: Bites. Melee weapon attack, +0 to hit, reach 0 ft., one creature in the swarm’s space. On a hit, the target is infested by 1d4 rot grubs. At the start of each of its turns, the target takes 1d6 piercing damage per infesting grub. Applying fire to the bite wound before the end of the target’s next turn deals 1 fire damage to the target and kills the grubs from that bite. Once that window passes, they are too deep under the skin for fire at the wound. If the target ends its turn with 0 HP while infested, it dies. An effect that cures disease kills all rot grubs infesting the target.
sections.Encounter ecology: Rot grubs gather in corpses and decaying material and may attack a creature that disturbs them. Burning an infested corpse kills its remaining grubs.
